title: Leaf solar parity ledger v1
description: Every Branch2025 command surface registration, classified once, with the wave that owes it parity. The status script enforces the rules this schema cannot express (row count against registrations_expected, alias targets, receipt duty).

registrations_expected.description: The registration count the ledger must account for, row for row.

source.description: How the expected count was produced, so it can be reproduced.

global.description: The registration's global identifier. Unique across the ledger.

class.description: T tool, F feature, P platform-only, V view-only, H host-bound, A alias.

capability.description: Kebab-case capability name. Several rows may share one capability; it is proven once.

capability_version.description: Bumped when the capability's observable behaviour changes, which stales every older receipt.

wave.description: The delivery wave that owes this row parity. Null means out of scope, which V, H and P rows must justify.

status.description: Unresolved means the classification itself is still open.

exclusion_rationale.description: Why this row owes no wave. Required, non-empty, for a V, H or P row with a null wave.

alias_of.description: For class A only: the global of the row this one aliases. The target must exist and must not itself be an alias.

evidence.description: Where the classification came from: file, line, command output.
